content.text: You’ve built a digital product—an ebook, course, or template—but you can’t sell it because Stripe and PayPal don’t operate in Kenya. Conventional payment gateways lock you out, and workarounds like VPNs or third-party processors are unreliable. This isn’t a regional limitation; it’s an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] problem. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves it. This post breaks down how [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-8|crypto]] payment gateways, combined with decentralized hosting and automated delivery, give you a fully operational online store without depending on any single platform. No subscriptions. No rent. Full ownership. Built for creators in Kenya and beyond who choose [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-13|The Real]] over workarounds.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned digital commerce stack. It combines free and paid tools to create a system where you control every layer: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. The core is a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. This isn’t a patch for Stripe’s absence; it’s a base-layer solution. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free hosting), uses Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, stores orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and delivers files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The architecture is modular, meaning you own and control each component. No platform can shut you down, and no subscription can expire. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not a workaround, but a permanent solution.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how the stack operates: A customer lands on your store, hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They select a product priced in USD, but payment is processed in crypto (e.g., USDT on BSC for low fees). NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and sends a webhook to your backend (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script). The backend checks the payment status, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and triggers file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The customer receives their product instantly, and you retain full data ownership. The system is automated, secure, and scalable. For example, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing to ensure reliability. This isn’t duct-taped code; it’s enterprise-grade infrastructure tailored for digital creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment gateways are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, and you’ve been locked out of Stripe or PayPal, this is for you. It’s also for creators who value ownership over convenience. You’re not renting infrastructure; you’re building it. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates to deploy your stack in 48 hours. This isn’t a tool for those who want someone else to solve their problems. It’s for creators who understand that infrastructure sovereignty is the only way to future-proof their business. If you’re in Kenya, Ghana, Zimbabwe, or any region facing financial isolation, this is your solution.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership of your online store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack’s components are chosen for their reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, scalable hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without server management. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no buyer account requirements. Each component is independent, so you’re not locked into any platform. For example, if Google Sheets becomes unavailable, switch to Supabase with minimal changes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates to assemble these components into a cohesive system. This isn’t a fragile setup; it’s a robust architecture designed to withstand regional restrictions and platform changes.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack based on your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for beginners, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers advanced features like email configuration and end-to-end testing. If you prefer to build from scratch, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates. Deploy your stack on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up NOWPayments for crypto processing, and configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products, test the system, and launch. The process is documented step-by-step, and support is available for 30 days. This isn’t a theoretical exercise; it’s a practical solution you can deploy today. Take control of your commerce infrastructure and stop depending on platforms that don’t serve you.

It includes hosting (GitHub Pages/Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers/Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase/Google Sheets), file delivery (Google Drive/Cloudflare R2), and crypto payment processing (NOWPayments). The system is modular, automated, and designed to give digital creators full control without relying on third-party platforms.
Crypto payment gateways like NOWPayments process transactions with a 0.5% fee and no KYC.

Ready to deploy your sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints, templates, and guides to build your infrastructure in 48 hours. No more relying on platforms that don’t serve you. Own your stack, own your business.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). 2. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 5. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Set up file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Load your products and test the system end-to-end. 8. Launch your store and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates. While some technical understanding is helpful, the process is designed to be accessible for digital creators.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. The stack uses serverless tools like Cloudflare Workers and GitHub Pages, so there’s no server management required.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a reliable service, but if it fails, you can switch to another crypto gateway. The stack is modular, so components are replaceable.
Can I scale this for more products?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and Complete Builder Kit ($197) include scaling playbooks to handle more products and higher traffic.
